summary: Phases 3 & 4 desktop portal review (1440x900) + mobile regression (390x844) PASSED end-to-end on the live preview. Desktop: /signin and /signup render the two-panel auth-split (dark brand left, form right); login with e2e_test_1786703401@example.com worked on first attempt (no CORS flake). Dashboard: 'Have a query' pill opens the centred 'Message us directly' DesktopDialog (testID concierge-sheet, measured width=600px) with concierge-input, concierge-send, concierge-sheet-close and Cancel; close X dismisses it. action-meter opens the centred 'Meter installation' dialog (meter-install-modal, measured width=720px) with 4 type cards in a row (mi-type-smart/new/upgrade/other), mi-fuel-electricity visible beside mi-contact-phone, mi-notes beside mi-time; selecting 'Something else' (mi-type-other) hides fuel chips and shows the 'Not needed for this request.' text; meter-install-modal-close dismisses. desk-renewals-viewall / desk-task-renewals-cta are absent on this empty account (acceptable). Sidebar nav: /sites shows sites-desktop with title 'Sites', sites-add-new, sites-search, sites-business-chip (opens Switch business sheet listing 'All businesses', 'My business', 'Bayo's Cleaning Ltd', biz-add-site, biz-add-business) and the sites-empty panel; no mobile back-arrow. /reports -> reports-desktop + reports-empty. /renewals -> renewals-desktop + renewals-empty. Framed centred pages (visual check at ~760px): /profile, /support, /quote/new, /scan all render centred inside the portal canvas with sidebar+topbar still visible — no overflow. /documents/sr_loa_01/review still shows desktop-sign-panel. REMEMBER BUSINESS: picked biz-option-<id> on /sites (chip became 'My business'), performed a full browser reload — chip still read 'My business' (NOT 'All businesses'); then switched back to All businesses successfully. MOBILE REGRESSION (390x844): /signin has NO auth-split (original mobile form); dashboard renders original mobile layout with bottom tab bar (height=53) and no desktop sidebar/topbar; talk-to-human opens concierge-sheet as a bottom sheet with NO close X (concierge-sheet-close absent — correct per spec); mobile /sites shows mobile layout (sites-desktop absent) and /reports mobile (reports-desktop absent). Only non-functional note: mobile re-open of meter-install-modal in the same session appeared blocked by the still-open concierge bottom sheet (test-interaction artefact, not a product bug — desktop version of the same component works perfectly). No functional bugs found. React Native Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver) continue to appear in console — non-blocking, same as iteration_30.

issues: On DESKTOP the business switcher opens as a bottom sheet pinned to the bottom of the viewport (same component as mobile) instead of as a popover anchored above the content/chip. It functionally works and the Phase 3 spec explicitly only lists Renewals and contract rate cards as right-side drawers, but the review bullet mentions 'switcher dropdown opens above content' which this does not do — flag for product review.

react_native_issues.issue: Console still prints: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"', 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents', and 'Animated: `useNativeDriver` is not supported ... Falling back to JS-based animation'. Non-blocking cosmetic warnings only; same as iteration_30. Reference: multiple components using shadow.card from theme and app/documents/[id]/review.tsx:475.

action_items: (Optional) Consider rendering the business switcher as a positioned popover on desktop (anchored to sites-business-chip / reports-business-chip) instead of the shared bottom sheet, so it 'opens above content' per the Phase 4 brief.

(Optional) Add testID="desktop-frame" to the 'page' wrapper View in /app/frontend/src/components/desktop-frame.tsx (line 42, styles.page) so automated tests can assert the framed-panel state for /profile, /support, /quote/new, /scan without relying on visual layout alone.
(Optional) Clean up RN Web deprecation warnings: migrate shadow* props to boxShadow and pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents (same as iteration_30 ask).
critical_code_review_comments: src/business/business-context.tsx stores the last selected business under a per-user key (uch_active_business_id:<userId|email>) and only restores IDs that still exist in the current list — safe against stale cross-user state; verified persistence across a full browser reload.

src/desktop/overlays.tsx DesktopDialog correctly caps width via maxWidth prop (600px concierge, 720px meter) and renders a backdrop + close X — matches the Phase 3 brief; both measured widths were exactly as specified.

src/components/meter-install-modal.tsx renders separate desktop (DesktopDialog) and mobile (bottom sheet) branches and correctly hides the fuel row when selected type === 'other', showing the 'Not needed for this request.' hint — verified.

src/components/desktop-frame.tsx cleanly keeps a stable element tree across shell/column/page states so the Expo-Router navigator never remounts — good. The 'page' wrapper (styles.page, maxWidth=760) is applied but lacks a testID so automated assertions have to fall back to screenshot/measured width.

src/utils/use-desktop.ts isWideDesktopRoute() correctly lists dashboard/sites/reports/renewals/site-detail/documents — all other portal pages (profile, support, quote, scan) correctly fall through to the framed 'page' style.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused the live e2e test account only. No messages, meter requests, sites, quotes, or scans were submitted. Business selection was changed to 'My business' temporarily to verify persistence then switched back to 'All businesses' at the end as requested.
